## Meeting Purpose

[Discuss and plan the implementation of NFC functionality for a canteen ordering system.](https://fathom.video/share/EnYzrnxYo5jcRvzo1Lzu56ktnAgC5EN_?tab=summary&timestamp=120.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [Implement a simple NFC-based check-in system for the canteen, focusing on an easy solution first](https://fathom.video/share/EnYzrnxYo5jcRvzo1Lzu56ktnAgC5EN_?tab=summary&timestamp=351.0)
  - [Use NFC cards with unique IDs to retrieve user meal information for the current day](https://fathom.video/share/EnYzrnxYo5jcRvzo1Lzu56ktnAgC5EN_?tab=summary&timestamp=186.0)
  - [Consider fallback options (QR codes, manual ID input) for devices without NFC support](https://fathom.video/share/EnYzrnxYo5jcRvzo1Lzu56ktnAgC5EN_?tab=summary&timestamp=712.0)
  - [Plan to work together on implementing the NFC feature soon](https://fathom.video/share/EnYzrnxYo5jcRvzo1Lzu56ktnAgC5EN_?tab=summary&timestamp=791.0)

## Topics

### Current System Issues

  - [Paper-based system is stressful and inefficient](https://fathom.video/share/EnYzrnxYo5jcRvzo1Lzu56ktnAgC5EN_?tab=summary&timestamp=226.0)
  - [Some order contamination and invalid entries exist](https://fathom.video/share/EnYzrnxYo5jcRvzo1Lzu56ktnAgC5EN_?tab=summary&timestamp=387.0)
  - [Challenges with employees changing canteens and order management](https://fathom.video/share/EnYzrnxYo5jcRvzo1Lzu56ktnAgC5EN_?tab=summary&timestamp=387.0)

### NFC Implementation Plan

  - [Create a check-in page that listens for NFC read events](https://fathom.video/share/EnYzrnxYo5jcRvzo1Lzu56ktnAgC5EN_?tab=summary&timestamp=712.0)
  - [Use unique IDs on NFC cards to query the database for user's meal info](https://fathom.video/share/EnYzrnxYo5jcRvzo1Lzu56ktnAgC5EN_?tab=summary&timestamp=186.0)
  - [Implement API endpoints to get user meal data based on ID and current date](https://fathom.video/share/EnYzrnxYo5jcRvzo1Lzu56ktnAgC5EN_?tab=summary&timestamp=300.0)
  - [Consider adding a "delivered" flag to mark orders as completed](https://fathom.video/share/EnYzrnxYo5jcRvzo1Lzu56ktnAgC5EN_?tab=summary&timestamp=300.0)

### Fallback Options

  - [Include QR code scanning as an alternative to NFC](https://fathom.video/share/EnYzrnxYo5jcRvzo1Lzu56ktnAgC5EN_?tab=summary&timestamp=712.0)
  - [Add manual ID input option for devices without NFC support](https://fathom.video/share/EnYzrnxYo5jcRvzo1Lzu56ktnAgC5EN_?tab=summary&timestamp=712.0)
  - [Check for NFC availability in the browser and show appropriate input methods](https://fathom.video/share/EnYzrnxYo5jcRvzo1Lzu56ktnAgC5EN_?tab=summary&timestamp=712.0)

### Future Enhancements

  - [Implement a queue system for order preparation](https://fathom.video/share/EnYzrnxYo5jcRvzo1Lzu56ktnAgC5EN_?tab=summary&timestamp=327.0)
  - [Add functionality for employees to specify eating locations (different canteens, on-site, off-site)](https://fathom.video/share/EnYzrnxYo5jcRvzo1Lzu56ktnAgC5EN_?tab=summary&timestamp=486.0)
  - [Consider developing an iPad application for broader device support](https://fathom.video/share/EnYzrnxYo5jcRvzo1Lzu56ktnAgC5EN_?tab=summary&timestamp=660.0)

### Testing and Development

  - [Adrian considering ordering a tablet for on-site testing](https://fathom.video/share/EnYzrnxYo5jcRvzo1Lzu56ktnAgC5EN_?tab=summary&timestamp=523.0)
  - [Luís offers to work on the NFC implementation using his old Samsung tablet](https://fathom.video/share/EnYzrnxYo5jcRvzo1Lzu56ktnAgC5EN_?tab=summary&timestamp=625.0)
  - [Discussed potential use of Playwright and Superwright for end-to-end testing](https://fathom.video/share/EnYzrnxYo5jcRvzo1Lzu56ktnAgC5EN_?tab=summary&timestamp=902.0)
  - [Mentioned AI agents for test planning, generation, and healing in Playwright](https://fathom.video/share/EnYzrnxYo5jcRvzo1Lzu56ktnAgC5EN_?tab=summary&timestamp=902.0)
